# polkit

The pending polkit authentication request, its progress and the last failure.

The password never reaches Lua: a [secure field](../guide/input.md#secure-fields) with
`secure_submit = { capability = "polkit", action = "authenticate" }` sends it straight to the
Supervisor. The first submit starts polkit's helper; after that `prompt` and `messages` relay its
PAM conversation as on [`lock`](lock.md), and the same field answers each prompt.

```lua
column {
    visible = mantle.polkit:map(function(polkit)
        return polkit.active
    end, false),
    spacing = 8,
    children = {
        text {
            content = mantle.polkit:map(function(polkit)
                return polkit.message or ""
            end, ""),
        },
        text {
            content = mantle.polkit:map(function(polkit)
                return polkit.prompt and polkit.prompt.text or "Password"
            end, ""),
        },
        textfield {
            width = 280,
            height = 24,
            masked = mantle.polkit:map(function(polkit)
                return not (polkit.prompt and polkit.prompt.echo)
            end, true),
            secure_submit = { capability = "polkit", action = "authenticate" },
        },
        text {
            foreground = "#F38BA8",
            content = mantle.polkit:map(function(polkit)
                local last = polkit.messages[#polkit.messages]
                return last and last.text or polkit.error or ""
            end, ""),
        },
        list {
            direction = "horizontal",
            spacing = 8,
            items = mantle.polkit:map(function(polkit) return polkit.identities end, {}),
            key = function(identity) return tostring(identity.uid) end,
            each = function(identity)
                return rect {
                    on_click = function() mantle.polkit:select_identity(identity.uid) end,
                    children = { text { content = identity.name } },
                }
            end,
        },
        rect {
            on_click = function() mantle.polkit:cancel() end,
            children = { text { content = "Cancel" } },
        },
    },
}
```

## State

`mantle.polkit:get()` returns `PolkitState`, `nil` before the first push. A field marked `?` may be absent.

`mantle.polkit`'s payload. Every other field is empty while `active` is false.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action_id` | `string` | Action being authorized, e.g. `org.freedesktop.systemd1.manage-units`. |
| `active` | `boolean` | polkitd is waiting for the user to authenticate. |
| `authenticating` | `boolean` | An answer is with PAM, or typed before its prompt and held for it. A second submit is refused while true. |
| `error` | `string` | Drawable reason for the last failure, e.g. `"authentication failed"`. The prompt stays open to retry. |
| `icon_name` | `string` | Themed icon name, or empty when the caller set none. |
| `identities` | `PolkitIdentity[]` | The accounts polkit accepts, as it offered them; groups arrive already expanded. |
| `identity` | `integer` | The uid the next helper authenticates: this session's user if offered, else the first. |
| `message` | `string` | The action's prompt, e.g. `"Authentication is required to ..."`, in `en_US`: the locale the agent registers with. |
| `messages` | `PamNotice[]` | The helper's info and error lines, as on `mantle.lock`. |
| `prompt?` | `PamPrompt` | The helper's pending question, as on `mantle.lock`. `nil` until the first submit starts it. |

### `PamNotice`

One line a PAM module showed without asking anything, e.g. a fingerprint hint or a lockout.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `PamNoticeKind` | `"info"` or `"error"`. |
| `text` | `string` | What the module said, as it said it. |

### `PamNoticeKind`

What a `PamNotice` reports.

One of `"info"`, `"error"`.

### `PamPrompt`

A question a PAM module asked.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `echo` | `boolean` | The answer is meant to be seen: set the secure field's `masked` to `not echo`. |
| `id` | `integer` | Unique for this session, so two identical prompts in a row still differ. |
| `text` | `string` | PAM's own text, e.g. `"Password: "` or `"Verification code:"`. |

### `PolkitIdentity`

One account a polkit challenge accepts.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | Login name, or empty when the uid has no passwd entry. |
| `uid` | `integer` |  |

## Actions

Call each as `mantle.polkit:<action>(arguments...)`; `?` marks an argument you may omit.

| Action | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cancel` |  | Dismisses the prompt; the requesting program sees the request cancelled. |
| `select_identity` | `uid: integer` | Authenticates as `uid`, one of `identities`. Clears the prompt and error; the next submit starts PAM for it. After a submit it ends that conversation, which PAM may count as a failure. |

## Backend

On first read, registers as the authentication agent for `$XDG_SESSION_ID`'s session, at
`/org/mantle/PolicyKit1/AuthenticationAgent` with locale `en_US.UTF-8`, and again each time polkitd
restarts, cancelling the challenge the old polkitd held. If another agent already answers, it stays
off until polkitd restarts. polkitd accepts an answer only from uid 0, so the
[PAM worker](../../supervisor/src/pam_worker.rs) hands the password to polkit's root helper at
`/run/polkit/agent-helper.socket`. The agent is [`polkit.rs`](../../supervisor/src/polkit.rs).

## Gotchas

| Trap | Fix |
| :--- | :--- |
| A second program's prompt never shows | One request at a time: a request arriving while another is on screen is cancelled, and its program sees the cancel. Finish or `cancel` the first |
| Prompts go to another agent | polkit-gnome, hyprpolkitagent or similar registered first. Stop it and restart Mantle |
| The prompt stays open after a wrong password | By design: `error` says why, and the next submit starts a new helper |
| Another admin should authenticate | List `identities` and call `select_identity(uid)` from a click. The default is your own account when polkit offers it. Switching after a submit ends that attempt, which PAM may count |
| `prompt` is `nil` before anything is typed | polkit's helper starts on the first submit, because closing a helper that waits on a prompt counts as a failed attempt |

See also: [secure fields](../guide/input.md#secure-fields); [FAQ](../guide/faq.md#capabilities) for prompts that never appear.
